title: Yummy Crispy Polish Tofu Bowl
description: A quick, dairy‑free, one‑pot bowl featuring oven‑roasted tofu, fresh veggies, and vegan stracciatella cheese, served hot from a stone pot.
instructions: Preheat oven to 200°C and line a baking sheet with parchment.
Whisk soy sauce, maple syrup, sesame oil, minced garlic, and grated ginger in a bowl.
Toss tofu cubes in the sauce until coated, then sprinkle with cornstarch and stir to coat.
Spread tofu on the baking sheet and roast for 20 minutes, flipping halfway, until golden and crispy.
Steam broccoli florets for 3 minutes and sauté bell pepper and mushrooms in a pan with a splash of oil for 5 minutes.
Remove tofu from oven, let rest 5 minutes, then transfer it to a heated dolsot stone bowl.
Add the steamed broccoli, sautéed vegetables, and cooked quinoa to the bowl, mixing gently.
Sprinkle shredded vegan stracciatella cheese over the top, cover the bowl for 2 minutes to melt the cheese.
Drizzle any remaining sauce from the tofu pan over the bowl, then garnish with toasted sesame seeds.
Serve immediately, optionally adding sliced green onions for freshness.
